status: Written BEFORE carry_smooth=21 was run on any 2023-2024 data. Validation still unopened.
trigger: An externally supplied candidate strategy (research/phase2/candidate_external.py) showed its carry core, which re-ranks every 5 sessions, had half our turnover and higher Sharpe on 2023-24. Its overlay added ~0.10 Sharpe and was not adopted.
information_leak_disclosed: The IDEA that carry ranks need de-noising was prompted by 2023-24 evidence from the candidate. The specific rule was then chosen on 2021-22 only.
mechanism_measured_on_design_window: 58% of daily carry target changes in 2021-22 reversed within 5 sessions: near-tied names swapping ranks and swapping back. Each swap is a full-step trade that the drift band cannot suppress.

selection.criterion_declared_before_running: highest Sharpe at 1.5x costs; within 0.05 of best prefer smoothing over refresh (no phase dependence), then the shorter window

adoption_rule: Recommended for adoption. The 2023-24 run that follows is CONFIRMATION ONLY: the rule is not changed in response to it, and it would be reverted only if that run revealed a bug or a failure mode (e.g. constraint adjustments, turnover far above design-window levels).

outcome.note: Improves every out-of-sample block at every cost multiplier. No bug or failure mode found, so adopted per the rule above.
